stem.text: In acidic conditions, iodine reacts with propanone in a substitution reaction.

The kinetics of the reaction are investigated using a colorimeter. As the $\text{I}_2$ reacts, the yellow/brown colour of the $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ fades to colourless, changing the absorbance of the solution. Known concentrations of $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ are used to prepare a calibration curve graph and the absorbance is then measured as the reaction proceeds.

stem.alt: Calibration graph: concentration of iodine (×10-3 mol dm-3, 0 to 0.30) against absorbance (0 to 0.6); points lie on a straight line rising from absorbance 0.1 to 0.5.
Graph of absorbance (0 to 0.6) against time/s (0 to 60): curve falls from about 0.5 at 0 s to about 0 at 60 s.
